title: Front Desk Standards Card: Arrival, Check-In and Visit Close by In-Person Appointments Visit Type
content:
Front desk figures for In-Person Appointments, by visit type: when the patient is asked to arrive, how late a patient may still be seen, whether and when MyLinden e-check-in opens, when intake forms are due, which copay is drawn at check-in, how far behind the clinician must be running before a checked-in patient may leave and rebook, and how soon the after-visit summary is posted.

| Visit type | Arrive early (minutes) | Late-arrival grace (minutes) | Late-arrival limit (minutes) | E-check-in offered | E-check-in opens (hours before start) | Intake forms due (hours before start) | Copay drawn at check-in | Clinician delay allowing rebooking (minutes) | After-visit summary posted within (hours) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Nurse Visit | 10 | 10 | 15 | Yes | 72 | 0 (none required) | primary | 20 | 24 |
| Established Patient Office Visit | 10 | 10 | 15 | Yes | 72 | 0 (none required) | primary | 30 | 24 |
| New Patient Office Visit | 20 | 15 | 20 | Yes | 72 | 48 | primary | 30 | 24 |
| Annual Preventive Exam | 15 | 15 | 20 | Yes | 72 | 24 | none | 30 | 24 |
| Specialist Consultation | 15 | 15 | 20 | Yes | 72 | 48 | specialist | 30 | 48 |
| In-Office Procedure Visit | 20 | 10 | 15 | No | 168 | 72 | specialist | 45 | 48 |
| Advanced Imaging Appointment | 30 | 10 | 15 | No | 72 | 48 | specialist | 45 | 72 |

## Card notes

- **Arrive early**: minutes before the scheduled start the patient is asked to arrive.
- **Late-arrival grace**: minutes after the scheduled start within which a late patient is still seen with no consequence.
- **Late-arrival limit**: minutes after the scheduled start beyond which the patient can no longer be checked in and the visit is handled as a late cancellation.
- **E-check-in offered** and **opens**: whether portal e-check-in is offered for the visit type, and how many hours before the start it opens.
- **Intake forms due**: hours before the start by which intake forms must be completed in the portal; 0 means none are required.
- **Copay drawn at check-in**: which insurance copay the visit type draws, primary, specialist or none.
- **Clinician delay allowing rebooking**: minutes the clinician must be running behind the scheduled start before a checked-in patient may leave and rebook with no fee and no count.
- **After-visit summary**: hours after completion within which the summary is posted to the portal.

## Reading the card (hypothetical arrivals)

- A patient for a New Patient Office Visit who arrives 15 minutes after the start is inside the 15-minute grace; one who arrives 21 minutes after the start is past the 20-minute limit.
- For a Nurse Visit, an arrival 12 minutes after the start is past the 10-minute grace but inside the 15-minute limit.
- The In-Office Procedure Visit carries an e-check-in opening of 168 hours but does not offer e-check-in; the Advanced Imaging Appointment likewise reads No.
